programs.title: Xploration Outer Space S2 - "Aliens"
programs.desc: Join Host Emily Calandrelli as she explores the latest in science’s search for life outside of planet Earth.

programs.title: Xploration Outer Space S3 - "Citizen Science"
programs.desc: Host Emily Calandrelli discovers various ways the public is helping scientists explore outer space; from sending bacteria samples to the International Space Station to tweeting observations about the Northern Lights.

programs.title: Xploration Outer Space S3 - "Surviving Space"
programs.desc: Host Emily Calandrelli visits NASA’s Swamp Works, which tests space suits and machines for Mars-like conditions.

programs.title: Xploration Awesome Planet S6 - "Slovenia"
programs.desc: In this episode, we travel to the country of Slovenia and look at how karst rock has led to the formation of over 12,000 caves across the country.

programs.title: Xploration Awesome Planet S6 - "Animal Rescue"
programs.desc: In this episode, we will visit a few different animal rescues centers starting with the marine mammal centre in Vancouver as they tend to orphaned harbor seals.

programs.title: Xploration Awesome Planet S6 - "Invasive Planet"
programs.desc: In this episode, we see a few different ways researchers are fighting invasive plants, animals, and materials in native habitats.
